The NCA-AIIO certification is an entry-level credential that validates the foundational concepts of AI computing related to infrastructure and operations. In this course you will learn everything you need to know to pass the certification exam.

Andrew Brown developed this course.

🔗 More resources: https://www.exampro.co/nca-aiio
